children: Enova International entered into a Mutual Termination Agreement and Release with Grasshopper Bancorp, formally ending their planned merger. Effective October 16, 2026, Enova made a $4,000,000 cash payment to Grasshopper, and neither party owes additional fees or liabilities. The prior Agreement and Plan of Merger, originally signed December 10, 2025 and amended December 18, 2025, has been mutually terminated, allowing both companies to move forward independently.
: Mutually end previously announced merger transaction
: Merger no longer proceeding by mutual decision
